tool_reviews.name: ImagesV2
tool_reviews.price: Free: 3 credits on sign-up (the first image costs 3 instead of 10). Yearly: Starter $49.90/yr (12,000 credits, ~$4.16/mo), Pro $199.90/yr (60,000, ~$16.66/mo), Ultra $499.90/yr (240,000, ~$41.66/mo). Monthly: Starter $8.40 (list $14.90, 1,000 credits), Pro $33.90 (list $39.90, 5,000), Ultra $84.90 (list $99.90, 20,000). One-time packs, credits never expire: Taster $9.90 (500 credits), Starter $39.90 (5,000), Pro $99.90 (20,000), Max $199.90 (50,000). No free trial on paid plans; all purchases final and non-refundable.

tool_reviews.name: Retouchia
tool_reviews.price: Free: 5 credits on sign-up (~1 image), no card required, full-resolution downloads. One-time packs only, no subscription: Basic $9.99 (shown against a $12 anchor, "Save 16%", 350 credits, advertised as ~70 images), Pro $29.99 (anchor $39.90, "Save 24%", 1,200 credits, ~240 images). Paid credits expire 365 days after purchase. Payment is processed by Waffo Pancake.

tool_reviews.name: Money Tracker (Expense & Budget)
tool_reviews.price: Free with ads: manual entry, categories, budgets, charts, reports, multi-currency, split (AA) books and exports all work without paying. Premium is sold only inside the app stores - the vendor's own site publishes no price anywhere in its 45 locales. Apple's listing shows Yearly Premium $29.99 and Monthly Premium $2.99; Google Play lists in-app purchases at $2.99-$29.00 per item. Premium removes ads and adds unlimited AI entry, bill import (CSV, Excel, PDF or images), Android Smart Notification Entry, app lock, more books and accounts, and team books.

editorial_note: AIToolsEssentials separates editorial scoring from affiliate and sponsor relationships.
